name: Abusing Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility of caring for and guiding children with both discipline and love. Proverbs instructs believers to train children in the right way, assuring that correction, when applied properly, does not harm but leads to lasting growth. Jesus warns strongly against causing harm to little ones who believe, highlighting the seriousness of offenses against children. Fathers are called to nurture their children without provoking them to anger, fostering their spiritual growth in the Lord's admonition while providing protection under God's care.
